_what: By-eye capture class of the 40 drawn library manuscript pages (#5277); key = row index of lib-draw.jsonl. Labelled 2026-09-30 from contact-sheet THUMBNAILS (~520 px tall, image opened); pages 1, 8, 9 and 22 were also opened as full-resolution arm crops. Classes: dark = dark/stained low-contrast parchment (the reading difficulty of Jerusalem SMMJ 36); clean = light leaf with legible ink (the ONB Syr. 1 kind); bilevel = an already-binarised microfilm scan; blank = cover or blank leaf. No library page is a dark spread photographed on black, which is the Jerusalem capture.
